setup.learned_gate: 32 hidden units, deterministic top-8 inference, Bernoulli + straight-through training

interpretation.positive: The learned gate receives nonzero gradients, changes its parameters, selects exactly 8/32 units per sample at inference, and learns disjoint majority masks for the two context values. Flipping the context reduces old-task accuracy to chance.
interpretation.not_proven: Old-task final accuracy is essentially the same as dense/static baselines. The lower measured forgetting partly reflects lower pre-task accuracy; this does not demonstrate a retention improvement.
interpretation.limits: Synthetic two-task binary functions only; no BNN, metaplastic optimizer, replay, real perceptual data, sparse expert kernels, model-family coupling, Android/ARM measurement, or production consumer.
